title: Odile and the Postcards
author: Vesper Marchetti
blurb: Quentin Coldharbour, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
